::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
One group, three names: Bharat Semi (founded late 2021), its design division 3rdiTech (IIT Delhi-linked; iDEX winner; co-founder Dr Mukul Sarkar), and DV2JS Innovation LLP (incorporated January 2018), the entity on the official PDLI list. All share partners Vrinda Kapoor and Vinayak Dalmia. Raised a $24M all-equity seed round in November 2026 (Info Edge, South Park Commons, Indusbridge Ventures; Micromax, Valour Capital, Gaingels). About 75 staff across New Delhi, Bengaluru and Santa Clara; CTO Boyd Fowler was previously CTO at OmniVision. Design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon; 3rdiTech signed a vision-systems MoU with Kaynes Semicon and SPARSHIQ (Sept 2025). A separate fab project announced in 2024 with a US Space Force technology partnership remains in development and is not funded by the seed round. The group link is inferred from shared partners and press descriptions; no single page states all three relationships.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Programmable image sensors that integrate capture, signal processing and AI inference on one chip (Gen-1 in prototyping, Gen-2 prototypes expected mid-2027), and — via the DLI project — a low-light image sensor with single-photon detection for security, surveillance and automotive cameras.
